title: Bounded run between configurations
statement: Let $R$ be a $K$-tape machine over input alphabet $\Gamma$ and state set $S$, let $x$ be a finite input over $\Gamma$, let $a,b$ be configurations on $x$, let $y,n$ be designated states, let $\beta$ assign an integer base position to each work tape, and let $\rho,t$ be natural numbers. The run of $R$ from $a$ reaches $b$ in exactly $t$ steps; at every earlier time $u<t$ its state is neither $y$ nor $n$; and at every time $u\le t$, each work-tape head is at distance at most $\rho$ from its assigned base position.
